title: Bound retries for pinned CI tool downloads
head: cloud/fv-base-asset-retry-1
body:
GitHub release-asset 503/504 responses previously exhausted Gitleaks retries quickly and failed actionlint immediately. Both pinned installers now retry all curl errors within a 600-second retry window, cap each transfer at 60 seconds, and report the asset, last HTTP status and curl exit code on final failure.

Validation: both unchanged installers recovered through a local 503, 503, 200 sequence using their real checksum-pinned archives; bash syntax checks and actionlint across all six workflows passed. Full-budget persistent-504 checks are running and receipts will be published separately. Version pins, checksums, upstream URLs, workflow files, cache keys and job shape are unchanged.
